findings.title: Refused restart reports a retained armed installation as failed and idle
findings.proof_basis: Actual shared ReleaseInstall, macOS Installer.arm_swap and TerminationCoordinator; exact ARMED from emitted shell; private physical stage retained and kernel-exclusive Linux rename after private launcher PID exits. Native AppKit/APFS unexecuted.
findings.guarantee_details: Asynchronous native installation ownership remains live after Lua terminalizes operation failed and clears busy; visible receipt and retry admission do not represent native pending owner. No assertion of withdrawn install consent, mandatory cancellation or promised rollback.

cases: accepted publication admission with asynchronous lease pending
refused publication admission before emergency deadline
duplicate physical worker lease refusal in both scenarios
retained staged bytes publish on later private launcher PID exit
reproduction.observed: Accepted control remains restarting/busy=true. Refusal yields restarting,failed/busy=false exit=0 lease=0 schedule=0, yet original worker retains stage+lease and later publishes CHOSEN/previous ORIGINAL. Duplicate worker exit4 prevents simultaneous swap.

root_cause.description: Exact ARMED is treated as completed install by common coordinator. A later early terminal-admission refusal maps to install-failed/free, with no representation of retained pending-on-quit worker. Shared fail and actual binding perform no stage cleanup/disarm.

findings.silent_failure: An error is visible/logged, so not fully silent. Missing information is that the installation remains armed and owns the native slot: translated UI says installation failed, permits normal retry while original may still complete on next exit. Original install consent remains valid.
findings.regression_test: Drive actual chosen-release bind through physical ARMED then publication-admission refusal; assert session/page stays reconciled with pending native worker (or explicit proven retirement), and no failed/idle success model while it holds slot. Include accepted async lease, deadline fallback, page close, duplicate-worker lease refusal, stage retention and worker expiry.
